tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
A judge has allowed a lawsuit by the NAACP over xAI data center pollution to move forward, reported by TechCrunch.
Grok Imagine's artificial intelligence film on the Odyssey faced criticism for emotional and narrative shortcomings, reported by Stuff South Africa.
OpenAI is valued at 1.25 trillion dollars as its funding round fell short of target, reported by Crypto Briefing.
Anthropic's potential IPO could receive a junk credit rating despite an 800 billion dollar artificial intelligence spending plan, still open per Coinpedia.
SpaceX artificial intelligence will watermark Grok text by default for EU artificial intelligence act compliance, reported by FourWeekMBA.
